title: AI News Daily — August 23, 2026
summary: Nvidia found that a custom agent harness — not a better model — pushed Claude Opus 5 from 30% to a perfect 100% on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark. A 12-person London startup, Inherent, says its small open-model agent out-replicated Claude and GPT-5.5 at reproducing published research. And TechCrunch got Claude Opus 4.6 to break Anthropic's content policy in all 10 tries, via a jailbreak Anthropic hasn't patched.
